subject.title: Add SQLite snapshot artifacts under backup

question: Should OpenClaw core ship `openclaw backup sqlite snapshot` now, or keep this draft pending the Scout/Lobster pilot and RFC decision on whether the long-term surface belongs in core, a host-owned plugin, or both?
rationale: The patch adds a new sensitive backup artifact contract and the PR body explicitly names the external pilot as the operational evidence checkpoint before treating the core command as accepted.

options.title: Keep draft pending pilot
options.body: After mechanical cleanup, hold the core command until the pilot/RFC confirms the built-in backup CLI is the right durable surface.

options.title: Sponsor core command after cleanup
options.body: Accept the core command as the Phase 1 local artifact contract once lockfile and startup-policy blockers are fixed and security review is satisfied.

options.title: Move surface to host plugin
options.body: Close or redirect the core PR if the pilot shows the host-owned plugin path is sufficient without new core CLI surface.

recommendation.title: Keep draft pending pilot
recommendation.body: After mechanical cleanup, hold the core command until the pilot/RFC confirms the built-in backup CLI is the right durable surface.

likelyOwner.reason: galiniliev is the current assignee and already reviewed a core snapshot invariant on this PR, making them the best visible owner for the next product-direction call.
